title: Dune Banned AI in 1965?! The Real CS Behind It 🤯 #shorts
description:
Dune: Part Three lands December 18 - but did you know Dune banned AI back in 1965? The Butlerian Jihad, a letter from 1863, and why the word "computer" first meant a PERSON.

Ban thinking machines, or keep them? Pick your side in the comments.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dune_(novel) (the Butlerian Jihad backstory, Mentats as human computers)
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darwin_among_the_Machines (Samuel Butler, The Press, 13 June 1863)
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Computer_(occupation) (earliest known use of "computer" for a person: 1613)
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dune:_Part_Three (release date: December 18, 2026)

Narration is an AI voice. Not affiliated with Warner Bros., Legendary or the Herbert estate.
